priorityList: Cast Voltaic Blaze if Flame Shock is not active
Cast Surging Totem
Cast Lava Lash if Hot Hand or Whirling Fire is active
Cast Sundering, aiming to sync every other cast with Surging Totem
Cast Windstrike during Ascendance procs
Cast Lava Lash
Cast Stormstrike
Cast Voltaic Blaze
Cast Lightning Bolt at 5+ Maelstrom Weapon stacks
Feral Spirit: Cast on cooldown
Primordial Wave: Cast on cooldown
Lightning Bolt: Cast at 10 stacks of Maelstrom Weapon if the Primordial Wave buff is active
Ascendance: Cast on cooldown
Windstrike: Use as the primary strike during Ascendance

Flame Shock: Apply and maintain the damage-over-time effect
Lava Lash: Cast if Hot Hand is active
Ice Strike: Cast on cooldown
Frost Shock: Cast if Hailstorm is active
Stormstrike: Use as a filler to trigger Thorim's Invocation
